newsitem.title: CHINA: China Interbank Market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China Interbank Market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range in dull trade, with some banks continuing to sell on the secondary market.
"With a year-end liquidity squeeze, most banks and financial institutions do less business now," said one Chinese trader.
"The supply was sufficient on the market since some banks had increased deposits in the central bank and their demand for funds was less than before," another trader said.
Banks were major sellers and several non-bank financial institutions acted as major borrowers, traders said.
Traders expect rates to move around current levels in the short term in the absence of major market-moving news.
